description: Projets de production de biométhane, gaz bas-carbone et gaz de récupération par Gazéification Hydrothermale en France is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données recense les premiers projets industriels et démonstrateurs potentiels de Gazéification Hydrothermale (GH) en France. Il a été constitué dans le cadre de l’Appel à Manifestation d’Intérêt GH (AMI GH) réalisé en 2024 par NaTran auprès de différents porteurs de projets. Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Production. Its keywords are Gazéification Hydrothermale, Biogaz. The portal shows 2025-03-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
